title: General Geometry-Linked MeshCertificate
scope: exact rational vertex geometry and ordered triangle connectivity
signed triangle Jacobians proven equal to the determinant computed from source vertices
strictly positive triangle orientation and nondegeneracy
canonical global edge endpoint ordering and global edge ids
local-to-global edge orientation signs tied to actual triangle and edge endpoints
interior edge two-sided ownership with distinct incident cells and opposite orientations
boundary edge single ownership and nonempty labels
complete local-edge incidence proof preventing hidden duplicate/non-manifold ownership
injective interior/boundary edge-id consequences and interior/boundary disjointness
failure_policy: Malformed geometry, orientation, labeling, or ownership data must fail certificate generation/proof rather than propagate into downstream theorems.
nonclaims: No continuum H1/H(div) trace theorem is claimed.
No arbitrary binary floating-point mesh is silently promoted to exact geometry.
The v3.22 square-with-center fixture is an instance of the general certificate, not the definition of the general theorem.
